unitTitle: Past Perfect Simple - Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple

pairsWith.noteUz: Uch o'tgan zamon mashqlari va 1-8-unitlar takrori (Revision).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 8-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET + REVISION 1-8 (43-bet, PDF 42). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '8'.

CHAP USTUN:
8) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past perfect, past continuous or past simple, as in the example.' SURATLAR bilan: 1 (nusxa ko'chirish mashinasi) He was making (make) copies when the photocopier broke down (break down). 2 (taksi) He ...... (pay) the taxi driver as soon as they ...... (arrive). 3 (telefondagi erkak) He ...... (walk) down the street when his mobile phone ...... (ring). 4 (keksa ayol olma bilan) Mrs White ...... (make) an apple pie before her grandson ...... (visit) her. 5 (qiz sug'orgich bilan) She ...... (water) the flowers when her mother ...... (come) home from work.
9) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect.' 1 When I ...... (come) home from work I ...... (realise) that I ...... (forget) to turn off the iron. 2 I ...... (want) to do some shopping but when I ...... (get) into the car I ...... (notice) that I ...... (not/put) petrol in the tank. 3 Tom ...... (go) for a walk after he ...... (watch) the news. 4 I ...... (start) working at the National Bank after I ...... (graduate) from university. 5 Tania ...... (just/mop) the floor when her son ...... (spill) milk all over it.

O'NG USTUN:
10) 'Underline the correct word(s).' 1 I arrived/was arriving at the airport on time. 2 She was finishing/had finished her homework before she went to bed. 3 He swept/was sweeping the veranda when the doorbell rang. 4 Jack had brushed/was brushing his teeth before the water was cut off. 5 Sally ate/had eaten lunch before she went shopping. 6 He was having/had coffee with some friends when he heard the news. 7 He cut his finger as he was slicing/had sliced the bread. 8 I was fixing the car when I heard/had heard someone calling for help.
'Revision: Units 1 - 8':
11) 'Tick the correct sentence, as in the example.' 1 a) They're moving to the country next month. ✓ b) They move to the country next month. 2 a) Adam used drive a motorcycle. b) Adam used to drive a motorcycle. 3 a) He can't be his father. He's only five years older than him. b) He can be his father. He's only five years older than him. 4 a) Eddie was making a sandwich when the phone was ringing. b) Eddie was making a sandwich when the phone rang. 5 a) His watch is the most expensive of all. b) His watch is the more expensive of all. 6 a) They have gone to Vienna twice. b) They have been to Vienna twice. 7 a) I saw Maria when I go to Rome. b) I will see Maria when I go to Rome. 8 a) Would you like a little cereal for breakfast? b) Would you like a few cereal for breakfast?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '43'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past perfect, past continuous or past simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past perfect, past continuous yoki past simple shaklida qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BOG'LOVChIGA QARANG.

  when + qisqa uzilish → CONTINUOUS
    + SIMPLE
  as soon as / before → PERFECT +
    SIMPLE

  1 was making / broke down
    (NAMUNA)
  2 paid / had arrived (as soon as -
    kelib bo'lgach)
  3 was walking / rang (when)
  4 had made / visited (before)
  5 was watering / came (when)


⚠ 'A PHOTOCOPIER':

  = nusxa ko'chirish mashinasi.


⚠ 'TO BREAK DOWN':

  = buzilmoq (mashina).

items.textEn: He ___ (make) copies when the photocopier ___ (break down).
He ___ (pay) the taxi driver as soon as they ___ (arrive).
He ___ (walk) down the street when his mobile phone ___ (ring).
Mrs White ___ (make) an apple pie before her grandson ___ (visit) her.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Avval pishirdi (had made), keyin nabira keldi (visited).

items.textEn: She ___ (water) the flowers when her mother ___ (come) home from work.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past perfect shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYSI HARAKAT OLDINROQ?

  1 came / realised / had
    forgotten (unutish - oldinroq)
  2 wanted / got / noticed / hadn't
    put (benzin quymaslik -
    oldinroq)
  3 went / had watched (after -
    oldin ko'rgan)
  4 started / had graduated (after)
  5 had just mopped / spilled
    (just - oldinroq)


⚠ 'TO REALISE':

  = anglamoq, payqamoq.


⚠ 'THE TANK':

  = (benzin) baki.

items.textEn: When I ___ (come) home from work I ___ (realise) that I ___ (forget) to turn off the iron.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Uyga kelib angladim (V2) - unutgan edim (had V3).

items.textEn: I ___ (want) to do some shopping but when I ___ (get) into the car I ___ (notice) that I ___ (not/put) petrol in the tank.
Tom ___ (go) for a walk after he ___ (watch) the news.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Avval ko'rdi (had watched), keyin sayrga chiqdi.

items.textEn: I ___ (start) working at the National Bank after I ___ (graduate) from university.
Tania ___ (just/mop) the floor when her son ___ (spill) milk all over it.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Endigina yuvgan edi (had just mopped) - to'kdi (spilled).

exercises.explanationUz:
SIMPLE / CONTINUOUS / PERFECT.

  1 ARRIVED on time (qisqa)
  2 HAD FINISHED before she went
  3 WAS SWEEPING when the doorbell
    rang
  4 HAD BRUSHED before the water
    was cut off
  5 HAD EATEN before she went
  6 WAS HAVING coffee when he heard
  7 as he WAS SLICING (jarayonda
    kesib oldi)
  8 when I HEARD (qisqa uzilish)


⚠ 'TO SWEEP THE VERANDA':

  = ayvonni supurmoq.


⚠ 'THE WATER WAS CUT OFF':

  = suv o'chirildi.

items.textEn: I arrived/was arriving at the airport on time.
items.uz: Men aeroportga o'z vaqtida yetib keldim.

items.textEn: She was finishing/had finished her homework before she went to bed.
items.uz: U uxlashdan oldin uy vazifasini tugatgan edi.

items.textEn: He swept/was sweeping the veranda when the doorbell rang.
items.uz: Eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringlaganda u ayvonni supurayotgan edi.

items.textEn: Jack had brushed/was brushing his teeth before the water was cut off.
items.uz: Suv o'chirilishidan oldin Jek tishini yuvgan edi.

items.textEn: Sally ate/had eaten lunch before she went shopping.
items.uz: Xaridga chiqishdan oldin Salli tushlik qilgan edi.

items.textEn: He was having/had coffee with some friends when he heard the news.
items.uz: Yangilikni eshitganda u do'stlari bilan qahva ichayotgan edi.

items.textEn: He cut his finger as he was slicing/had sliced the bread.
items.uz: Non kesayotganda u barmog'ini kesib oldi.

items.textEn: I was fixing the car when I heard/had heard someone calling for help.
items.uz: Mashinani tuzatayotganimda kimdir yordam so'rab chaqirayotganini eshitdim.

items.textEn: a) They're moving to the country next month. b) They move to the country next month.
a) Adam used drive a motorcycle. b) Adam used to drive a motorcycle.
a) He can't be his father. He's only five years older than him. b) He can be his father. He's only five years older than him.
items.uz: U uning otasi bo'lishi mumkin emas. U undan atigi besh yosh katta.

items.textEn: a) Eddie was making a sandwich when the phone was ringing. b) Eddie was making a sandwich when the phone rang.
items.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda Eddi sendvich tayyorlayotgan edi.

items.textEn: a) His watch is the most expensive of all. b) His watch is the more expensive of all.
a) They have gone to Vienna twice. b) They have been to Vienna twice.
a) I saw Maria when I go to Rome. b) I will see Maria when I go to Rome.
a) Would you like a little cereal for breakfast? b) Would you like a few cereal for breakfast?

patterns.formula: KIM + V2 + as soon as + KIM + had + V3
patterns.exampleEn: He paid the taxi driver as soon as they had arrived.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular yetib kelishi bilanoq u taksi haydovchisiga to'ladi.

patterns.formula: When I + V2, I + V2 + that I + had + V3
patterns.exampleEn: When I came home I realised that I had forgotten to turn off the iron.
patterns.exampleUz: Uyga kelganimda dazmolni o'chirishni unutganimni angladim.

patterns.formula: KIM + had just + V3 + when + KIM + V2
patterns.exampleEn: Tania had just mopped the floor when her son spilled milk all over it.
patterns.exampleUz: Tania endigina polni yuvgan edi, o'g'li ustiga sut to'kdi.
